title: The $5B+ IPO calendar.
intro: The major private companies closest to a public-market decision, separated by what is filed, reported, and still unconfirmed.
disclaimer: Valuations are the latest publicly reported private-market figures. Timing is not issuer guidance unless a filing has been disclosed; this is a watchlist, not an offering calendar.

earnings.impact: JPMorgan's lending, deal pipeline, and capital-markets commentary is a read-through on private-company financing conditions. Watch for signals affecting Stripe, Brex, and Ramp.
TSMC's capacity and advanced-node outlook shapes the supply of the chips behind AI hardware. It matters for Groq, xAI, and Figure AI.
Blackstone's deployment and fundraising commentary helps frame demand for private credit and secondary liquidity. It is relevant to Stripe, Canva, and Databricks.
Visa's payment-volume and cross-border trends are a useful demand signal for fintech infrastructure. Watch the read-through for Stripe, Plaid, and Ramp.
Google Cloud growth and AI spending reset the competitive backdrop for model and data companies. It affects Isomorphic Labs, Waymo, and Anthropic.
Meta's AI capex and open-model strategy shape the economics of training and distribution. It matters for Mistral AI, Hugging Face, and xAI.
Azure demand and AI infrastructure spending remain central to the financing environment for frontier models. It affects OpenAI, Cohere, and Mistral AI.
Apple's services and platform-policy commentary matters for companies dependent on mobile distribution. It affects Discord, Perplexity, and Polymarket.
AWS growth and Amazon's AI capex are direct signals for cloud demand and startup infrastructure costs. It affects Anthropic, Scale AI, and Stripe.
Mastercard's transaction and cross-border data provides a consumer-spending read-through for private fintech. It affects Stripe, Plaid, and Ramp.

periods.label: Active filing
periods.title: A transaction is in motion
periods.description: Companies with a reported public filing or a specific reported listing window.

items.note: Anthropic announced a confidential U.S. IPO filing in June. The filing starts the process, but it does not establish a pricing date.
Reporting has framed SpaceX as a potential record-setting listing, but no public registration statement or confirmed date is available.

periods.label: 2027 watch
periods.title: Large, but not dated
periods.description: Major candidates that have reported preparation or a credible public-market path without a confirmed offer date.

items.note: OpenAI remains one of the market’s defining future listings, but reporting points to a later timetable rather than a 2026 debut.
Databricks has a mature operating profile, but its CEO has said 2027 is the earliest potential IPO window and that no confidential S-1 has been filed.

periods.label: No timetable
periods.title: Private-market giants to monitor
periods.description: Important $5B+ companies where a public debut remains possible but unannounced.

items.note: Stripe’s latest reported valuation reinforced its scale, while the company continues to keep investors waiting for a public-market debut.
Canva is a large software company frequently discussed as an IPO candidate, but it has not announced a listing timetable.
